400f015a-545f-4f01-b852-c5e63d21734b.title: Implement Database Schema for Financial Dashboard
400f015a-545f-4f01-b852-c5e63d21734b.description: Design and implement the database schema to store income, expenses, and net worth data for the financial dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Database schema is designed and documented.
Tables for income, expenses, and net worth are created and functional.
Database is integrated with the application backend.

605cd356-02a3-414f-99b5-3ea0494605d2.title: Create Backend API for Financial Data
605cd356-02a3-414f-99b5-3ea0494605d2.description: Develop a backend API that fetches and updates financial data (income, expenses, net worth) from the database.
acceptanceCriteria: API endpoints for income, expenses, and net worth are created.
API returns data in JSON format and handles errors gracefully.

8e77256b-80df-4e9c-836c-e27c5ecdd88a.title: Implement Real-time Data Updates
8e77256b-80df-4e9c-836c-e27c5ecdd88a.description: Set up real-time updates for the financial dashboard to reflect changes within 5 seconds of transaction entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Real-time updates are implemented using WebSockets or similar technology.
Dashboard reflects data changes within 5 seconds.
Testing confirms the accuracy of real-time updates.

ed2f29ed-2e8a-4091-9c90-80a6d9c3ebbd.title: Develop Frontend Dashboard UI
ed2f29ed-2e8a-4091-9c90-80a6d9c3ebbd.description: Design and implement the user interface for the financial dashboard, including graphs/charts for visual data representation.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard UI is responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Graphs/charts accurately represent income vs expenses data.
UI adheres to the design guidelines and is user-friendly.

5b233618-b8f2-404e-ba90-e3644569c7ef.title: Conduct Testing for Financial Dashboard Features
5b233618-b8f2-404e-ba90-e3644569c7ef.description: Perform testing on the financial dashboard to ensure all features (data retrieval, updates, UI responsiveness) are functioning correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: All features of the dashboard are tested for functionality and performance.
Bugs and issues are documented and tracked.
User acceptance testing is completed with feedback collected.
